scope: Independent local extraction; no AWS deployment, no remote account tests
limits: Browser demo and Python API are separate local surfaces; they are not integrated in this demonstration.
AWS bootstrap/guardrails excluded and must be independently designed; current IaC is a candidate, not an autonomous production deployment.
No account, deployment, cost, client outcome, throughput or availability was measured.
Automated axe checks on sampled flows are not a complete WCAG certification.
Lambda ZIPs contain deterministic application sources; they rely on the AWS-provided SDK at runtime, which must be pinned/packaged for a fully controlled client release.
Security scan exclusions remain explicit; zero failed checks does not establish production security.
execution_notes: Loopback servers and Terraform/TFLint IPC required sandbox escalation; no new AWS authorization or account access occurred.
The initial HTTP smoke read the pending state before asynchronous finalization; bounded GET polling was added and the smoke then passed.
Existing JS dependencies and the existing AWS provider were reused locally; no package download was required.
Two synthetic idempotency fixtures flagged by generic-api-key were replaced with explicit example identifiers; no secret allowlist added.
